culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total Investments | fair value 3,313,853 | percentage of net assets 158.88%

findings.detail: Total Investments is disclosed as 158.88%, but 3,313,853 divided by net assets of 2,088,932 rounds to 158.64%.
Liabilities Less Other Assets is disclosed as (63.27)%, but (1,316,616) divided by net assets of 2,088,932 rounds to (63.03)%.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation used the filing schedule itself. Table 50 reports net assets of 2,088,932 and total investments fair value of 3,313,853, so the percentage identity yields 158.64%, not the disclosed 158.88%. It also reports liabilities less other assets of (1,316,616), which yields (63.03)%, not (63.27)%. The two 0.24 percentage-point errors offset, and with cash equivalents of 4.39% the printed percentages still sum to 100.00%; that internal offset does not satisfy the per-row percentage-of-net-assets identity.
